title: Complaints up but unsafe food alerts not rising, says Lithuanian agency
summary:
There has been an increase in reports by consumers of potential violations involving food, according to Lithuania’s food agency.

From January to August 2025, the State Food and Veterinary Service (VMVT) received 2,311 notifications, while this year there were 2,639.

title: Finland assesses safety of plant-based dairy products
summary:
Microbiological risks and mycotoxin levels in plant-based dairy alternatives are generally low but consumer storage practices and product ingredients can significantly impact safety, according to research in Finland.

Findings come from a risk assessment as part of a project by Ruokavirasto (the Finnish Food Authority) and research organization VTT.
